services.sectionTitle: Complete expertise for all your needs
services.sectionDescription: From routine cleaning to home-care while you're away, our ten services cover all your cleaning, upkeep and concierge needs in Basel-Stadt and Basel-Landschaft.

bureaux.title: Office cleaning
bureaux.tagline: Spotless offices for a motivated team.
bureaux.longDescription: We handle daily, weekly or monthly upkeep of your premises: open spaces, meeting rooms, restrooms, kitchens and reception areas. A trained team, tailored products and a custom service plan that fits your rhythm and budget.

apresChantier.title: Post-construction cleaning
apresChantier.tagline: We erase every trace of the worksite.
apresChantier.longDescription: After works or renovation, we remove fine dust, paint residue, glue marks and debris. Your premises are returned clean, healthy and ready to use. Fast intervention with professional equipment.
includes: Deep cleaning of restrooms and kitchens

facades.title: Façade cleaning
facades.tagline: Bring back the shine to your building.
facades.overviewTitle: Façades like new, without damaging the surface
facades.longDescription: We clean your façades while respecting each material: stone, render, glass, wood or metal. Sand-blasting, low-pressure cleaning or biodegradable products — the method is adapted to your surface for a durable, damage-free result.

conciergerie.title: Concierge & buildings
conciergerie.overviewTitle: Regular upkeep of your building, hassle-free
conciergerie.longDescription: We provide full upkeep of common areas: staircases, landings, halls, elevators, bin rooms and outdoor surroundings. Regular presence, dedicated contact and transparent reporting for the management or association. Already have a provider for the stairs? We can also take on just the garage or any area you entrust to us.
includes: Window cleaning in halls and entrances

garages.title: Garage & parking cleaning
garages.description: Large garages and shared parking areas
garages.tagline: A clean large garage, even without the stairs contract.
garages.overviewTitle: The niche small providers can't cover
garages.longDescription: Cleaning a large underground garage requires professional equipment — scrubber-dryer, monobrush, industrial wet & dry vacuum — that most common-area providers don't have. We take on your parking even when the stairs are already handled by someone else: separate contract, flexible scheduling and spotless results.
includes: Degreasing and washing of concrete floors
Cleaning of markings, boxes and driveways
Dusting of low ducts and pipes
audience: Buildings whose stairs are already handled

photovoltaique.title: Solar panel cleaning
photovoltaique.overviewTitle: Clean panels can deliver up to 25% more output
photovoltaique.longDescription: Dust, pollen, droppings and air pollution reduce your PV panels' production. We clean them with deionised water and suitable brushes — no aggressive chemicals, no glass scratching and no impact on manufacturer warranties. Secure roof work with harness or lift, and a before/after photo report.
includes: Soft rotating brushes suited for glass
Visual inspection of connections and mounts
Recommended frequency: 1 to 2 times per year
audience: Managers and condos with productive roofs

arrosage.title: Plant watering
arrosage.description: Regular watering and while you're away
arrosage.tagline: Your plants cared for as if you were home.
arrosage.overviewTitle: A watering service designed for every occasion
arrosage.longDescription: Whether you're on holiday, on a business trip or simply want to delegate, we water your indoor and outdoor plants at the right frequency. Balconies, terraces, apartments, building lobbies or shared green spaces: each plant gets the right amount of water and a visual check at every visit.
includes: Watering at the right frequency for each plant
Alerts on any anomaly (yellow leaves, pest, wilting)
Regular or one-off visits as needed
Indoor plants, balconies, terraces and gardens
audience: Condos with plants in common areas
Tenants and owners who want to delegate

animaux.title: Cat & small pet care
animaux.description: Feeding and home visits while you're away
animaux.tagline: Travel with peace of mind — we come to you, your pet stays home.
animaux.longDescription: Away for a few days? We visit your home once or twice a day to feed your cat or small pet (rabbit, guinea pig, birds, fish…), change the water and check that all is well. The service takes place exclusively inside your home: no outdoor walks, and no boarding or accommodation at Nzo Immo Clean — your pet stays in its familiar surroundings.
includes: 1 or 2 home visits per day as needed
Refilling the bowl with your food
Visual check of your pet's wellbeing
Immediate alert if anything looks off
audience: Owners of small pets (rabbits, guinea pigs, birds, fish…)
People in hospital or travelling for work

jardins.title: Garden maintenance
jardins.tagline: Well-kept green spaces all year round.
jardins.overviewTitle: A garden cared for, built to last
jardins.longDescription: From mowing to pruning and weeding, we maintain your green spaces in tune with the seasons. Annual packages or one-off interventions, with a well-equipped team mindful of biodiversity.

debarras.title: Clearance services
debarras.description: Removal and sorting of bulky items
debarras.overviewTitle: A clean, fast and responsible clearance
debarras.longDescription: Cellar, attic, apartment or offices: we remove your bulky items, sorting what can be recycled, donated or resold. Transparent quote, fast intervention and waste-yard fees included — one provider, one price.
includes: Final cleaning of the cleared space

hero.title: for homes, businesses and real estate professionals
hero.description: A qualified field team and tailored services: offices, post-construction, façades, concierge, garages, solar panels, plant watering, cat & small pet care, gardens and clearance. Free quote in under 24 hours.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Nzo Immo Clean is committed to protecting user privacy and handling personal data transparently, in accordance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) and the GDPR where applicable.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: Nzo Immo Clean, Gellertpark 6, 4052 Basel — info@nzoimmoclean.ch.

sections.title: Data collected
sections.body: We collect only data needed to deliver our services:
list: Identity: first name, last name, company name
Mission data: address, surface area, frequency, notes
Technical: IP address, browser type, pages viewed

sections.title: Purposes
sections.body: Your data is used to handle quote requests, schedule and invoice services, send contractual information and improve our offering.

sections.title: Legal basis
sections.body: Processing is based on contract performance, legal obligations (notably accounting), your consent (newsletter, non-essential cookies), and our legitimate interest in improving user experience.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Client data is kept for the duration of the relationship plus 10 years, in line with Swiss accounting obligations. Prospect data is deleted after 3 years of inactivity.

sections.title: Recipients
sections.body: Your data is never sold. It may be shared with our technical sub-processors (hosting, email provider) who are contractually bound to protect it, or with authorities where legally required.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Under applicable law, you have the following rights:

sections.title: Exercising your rights
sections.body: To exercise your rights, write to info@nzoimmoclean.ch. We reply within 30 days. If unsatisfied, you may contact the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).

sections.title: Security
sections.body: We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures: HTTPS encryption, access control, regular backups and staff training.

cgv.title: Terms of sale
cgv.intro: These Terms of Sale govern the contractual relationship between Nzo Immo Clean and its clients, whether individuals or businesses.

sections.title: 1. Scope
sections.body: These terms apply to all cleaning, concierge and related services offered by Nzo Immo Clean. Any order implies full acceptance of these terms.

sections.title: 2. Quote and order
sections.body: Each service is preceded by a personalised quote valid for 30 days. The order is confirmed by signing the quote and paying any deposit.

sections.title: 3. Prices and invoicing
sections.body: Prices are in Swiss francs (CHF), Swiss VAT of 8.1% included where applicable. Invoices are issued after the service and payable within 30 days.

sections.title: 4. Payment
sections.body: Payments accepted by bank transfer, TWINT or credit card. Late payment automatically incurs interest at the Swiss legal rate.

sections.title: 5. Performance
sections.body: Nzo Immo Clean undertakes to perform services professionally and within agreed timeframes. The client must provide access and conditions necessary for proper performance.

sections.title: 6. Cancellation
sections.body: Any cancellation must be notified at least 48 hours before the scheduled intervention. Otherwise, 50% of the service amount may be invoiced.

sections.title: 7. Liability
sections.body: Nzo Immo Clean carries professional liability insurance. Any complaint must be made in writing within 7 days of the service.

sections.title: 8. Force majeure
sections.body: Neither party shall be liable for events of force majeure preventing performance of services.

sections.title: 9. Law and jurisdiction
sections.body: These terms are governed by Swiss law. Any dispute falls under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the canton of Geneva.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: The website www.nzoimmoclean.ch uses cookies to ensure proper operation, measure audience and improve your experience.

sections.title: What is a cookie?
sections.body: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device when you visit a website. It stores information about your browsing session.

sections.title: Essential cookies
sections.body: These cookies are strictly necessary and cannot be disabled:

sections.title: Analytics cookies
sections.body: Subject to your consent, we use analytics tools to understand site usage and improve it. These cookies collect aggregated, anonymised data.

sections.title: Third-party cookies
sections.body: Some embedded services (maps, videos) may set their own cookies, governed by their respective providers' policies.

sections.title: Manage your preferences
sections.body: You can configure your browser to block or delete cookies at any time. Disabling essential cookies may impair site functionality.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Cookies are kept for a maximum of 13 months. After that, your consent is required again.

story.title: A Basel GmbH, founded in February 2026
story.p1: Nzo Immo Clean GmbH was founded in February 2026 in Basel. We operate exclusively in the cantons of Basel-Stadt and Basel-Landschaft. From routine office cleaning to post-construction clean-up, building concierge and outdoor upkeep, every service is managed with the same rigour — from the first quote to the final quality check.
story.p2: Our clients — individuals, businesses, real estate agencies, property managers and associations — expect flawless execution and a responsive contact. From day one, we've relied on digital tools: real-time tracking, automatic photo reports, dedicated client portal. The quality of the field combined with the transparency of digital.

quote.text: A ground-level trade is judged by how clean the last corner is, not by the brochure. That's why we check every site, personally.
